name: material_define
description: Create a material, or fully replace one with the same id (upsert, FULL REPLACE: omitted optional fields are cleared, roughness resets to 0.9; send every field to keep). Its kind never changes. Library texture: kind "texture", textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials). Parquet: kind "paint", color = wood tone, pattern "herringbone" or "chevron". Define before using it in a finish.

id.description: Material id (1-64 characters), unique across all entities. Reference it from finishes and defaults.

kind.description: "paint" is a flat colour; "texture" adds a PBR texture set (needs textureUrl). Cannot change once defined.

color.description: Base colour as #rrggbb. For textures it is the fallback and tint colour.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte). Defaults to 0.9.

textureUrl.description: Texture set as "lib:<slug>"; read materials://list for the available slugs. Required when kind is "texture".

textureScale.description: Size in metres of one texture tile. Optional.

pattern.description: Parquet layout for floors (paint kind); color = wood tone.

plankWidthMm.description: Parquet plank width in mm (default 90; length is 7x).

material.description: The complete material. An existing id is fully replaced (omitted optional fields are cleared); kind cannot change.

name: material_remove
description: Delete a material. Fails with precondition_failed (naming the users) while a wall, a room (floor, ceiling or wall finish) or a default still uses it; reassign those first.

id.description: Id of the material to delete (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials). Fails with precondition_failed while any wall, room or default uses it.

name: wall_set_finish
description: Paint one or both faces of a wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room, which says which side faces the room). Pass roomId (strongly recommended) to paint only that room's stretch: a wall face can be shared by rooms, and without roomId every room on it is painted. Precedence: roomId finish, whole-face finish, room_set_wall_finish, scene default. materialId null clears. panelling: mouldings on the whole face.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

side.description: Face of the wall: "left" is on the left when walking from the wall start to its end on the plan (y grows down; describe_room says which face each room sees), "right" the other, "both" both. With roomId, "both" means every face the room adjoins.

materialId.description: Material id (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear. Library texture: first material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

panelling.description: Mouldings (boiserie): frames, dado (rail), frames+dado, none; null removes.

roomId.description: Room whose stretch of this side to paint (list_rooms). Strongly recommended: without it every room sharing the side is painted. precondition_failed if the room does not border that side. Beats the whole-side finish and room_set_wall_finish.

name: wall_set_structural
description: Mark a wall structural (never removable) or removable, or clear the mark. Exterior or at least 15 cm thick walls are structural by default; only a user may mark one removable.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

structural.description: true: structural (cannot be removed); false: removable; null: derived (exterior or at least 15 cm thick means structural). Only a user may set false on a default-structural wall.

name: room_set_wall_finish
description: Paint all the walls of a room (its own stretches only: neighbouring rooms keep their look). Replaces earlier per-wall paint of that room; a later wall_set_finish wins again. materialId null removes the room paint (no_wall_sides when no room edge runs along a wall face). panelling and cornice: mouldings, ceiling cornice.

roomId.description: Id of the room (rooms[].id from list_rooms).

materialId.description: Material id (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials), or null to clear. Library texture: material_define it first (textureUrl "lib:<slug>").

panelling.description: Mouldings (boiserie): frames, dado (rail), frames+dado, none; null removes.

corniceMm.description: Ceiling cornice height in mm; null removes.

description: Set the floor material of a room (null clears it so the scene default applies).

materialId.description: Material id (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials), or null to clear. Library texture: material_define it first (textureUrl "lib:<slug>").

name: item_place
description: Put a real, purchasable product into a room. Only products returned by search_products may be placed; an item without productRef or product is refused with precondition_failed ("search_products first"). Normally use place_item, which finds a valid position and rotation and fills in the product facts (price, dims, link) from the server's record; never type those yourself. The item is refused with placement_invalid when it would stand outside its room, overlap a wall or another item, or block a door swing (the message and hint say which and what to try). Windows, glazing, heavy wall mounts and walkways are checked by place_item and validate_layout. Item frame: the front faces plan +y at rotation 0; rotation is degrees counter-clockwise seen from above; a floor item has elevation 0. The id is derived (item-N) when omitted. At most 60 items per room. A lamp (product category lamp) gets a light that moves with it: lumens from the product page when stated (lights[].lumensSource "product"), else an estimate (floor 800, table 400, pendant 1000, wall 400 lm at 2700 K; "estimated"); autoLight false places it unlit. Undo removes the item and its light.
